title: One Picture, Many Impressions

scenes.title: Before speaking
scenes.alt: A student holds notes in front of classmates.
scenes.context: A student holds notes in front of classmates.
models: She looks nervous because she is holding her notes tightly.
It looks like a class presentation. The classmates seem interested.
Perhaps she feels confident and is simply waiting to begin.
scenes.suggestion: Suggest a friendly question that could make the first conversation easier.

scenes.title: During the talk
scenes.alt: A person rests their cheek on one hand while listening.
scenes.context: A person rests their cheek on one hand while listening.
models: He looks bored. I guess the talk is not interesting to him.
Perhaps he is tired, although the talk is interesting.
He seems quiet, but he could be thinking carefully.
scenes.suggestion: Suggest a friendly action that could help someone feel happier. Do not assume the person is sad.

scenes.title: At the museum
scenes.alt: Visitors watch a guide demonstrate a model.
scenes.context: Visitors watch a guide demonstrate a model.
models: The visitors look interested because they are watching closely.
The demonstration seems interesting, but perhaps some parts are confusing.
I think it looks like a group learning how a machine works.
scenes.suggestion: Imagine why a learner might admire someone. Give a reason based on their actions.

scenes.title: On the screen
scenes.alt: Two people react to something on a laptop.
scenes.context: Two people react to something on a laptop.
models: He looks surprised because his hand is over his mouth.
She seems excited. Perhaps they have received good news.
It looks like they are watching something funny, but we cannot see the screen.
scenes.suggestion: Use this if your interpretation involves very good news or strong happiness.

scenes.title: Following the instructions
scenes.alt: Two people examine loose pieces and a partly built model.
scenes.context: Two people examine loose pieces and a partly built model.
models: He looks confused. Perhaps the instructions are confusing.
She seems interested in how the model works.
I guess they enjoy the challenge, even though it looks difficult.
scenes.suggestion: Describe how the people seem to work together. Give a visible clue.

scenes.title: A round of applause
scenes.alt: One person holds notes while other people clap.
scenes.context: One person holds notes while other people clap.
models: The speaker seems relieved because the presentation appears to be over.
I think the classmates look pleased with the presentation.
Perhaps the speaker feels embarrassed by all the attention.
scenes.suggestion: Use this if your interpretation involves very good news or strong happiness.

scenes.title: Checking the time
scenes.alt: A person at a bus stop checks the time.
scenes.context: A person at a bus stop checks the time.
models: She looks worried because she is checking the time.
I guess she is waiting for a bus, but perhaps she is meeting a friend.
She seems calm to me. Checking the time does not prove she is nervous.
scenes.suggestion: Suggest a gentle way to relax if the person feels nervous. Avoid giving an impatient order.

scenes.title: Arranging the supplies
scenes.alt: People carry boxes and arrange food packages.
scenes.context: People carry boxes and arrange food packages.
models: It looks like a group preparing donations.
The people seem helpful because they are arranging supplies together.
Perhaps they are preparing an event rather than donating the food.
scenes.suggestion: Imagine who the group could contact to offer or ask for help.

scenes.title: Listening to the group
scenes.alt: Several people talk while one person listens with an open notebook.
scenes.context: Several people talk while one person listens with an open notebook.
models: The quiet person looks interested in the conversation.
I guess they are concentrating before sharing an idea.
Perhaps this is a new group and someone needs time to feel comfortable.
scenes.suggestion: Explain what could help someone feel welcome in the group.

scenes.title: Inside the gift
scenes.alt: Two people look into a bag; its contents are hidden.
scenes.context: Two people look into a bag; its contents are hidden.
models: They seem excited about what is inside the bag.
I think the gift looks surprising to them.
Perhaps one person is disappointed, but we need more information.
scenes.suggestion: Use this if your interpretation involves very good news or strong happiness.

scenes.title: Finding a piece
scenes.alt: A group works on a wooden puzzle.
scenes.context: A group works on a wooden puzzle.
models: The puzzle seems confusing because several pieces are still loose.
The group looks interested in solving it together.
I guess one person has found a solution while another is still thinking.
scenes.suggestion: Describe how the people seem to work together. Give a visible clue.

scenes.title: A moment on the bench
scenes.alt: Two friends sit beside a sports bag; one offers water.
scenes.context: Two friends sit beside a sports bag; one offers water.
models: One friend looks disappointed, but the reason is not clear.
The other person seems supportive because they are offering water.
Perhaps they are just resting after exercise rather than feeling sad.
scenes.suggestion: Suggest a friendly action that could help someone feel happier. Do not assume the person is sad.

scenes.title: Getting things ready
scenes.alt: People arrange decorations, cups and a cake.
scenes.context: People arrange decorations, cups and a cake.
models: It looks like a celebration is being prepared.
The activity seems exciting, and some people look happy.
Perhaps they are planning a surprise for someone.
scenes.suggestion: Use this if your interpretation involves very good news or strong happiness.

scenes.title: A quiet cup
scenes.alt: A person holds a mug; tissues are on the table.
scenes.context: A person holds a mug; tissues are on the table.
models: He looks tired, and perhaps he is taking a break.
I guess he feels under the weather because there are tissues nearby.
He seems thoughtful. The tissues alone do not tell us how he feels.
scenes.suggestion: Use this only as a possibility about feeling a little ill. The picture does not prove illness.

scenes.title: Working on a project
scenes.alt: Two people share materials while building a model.
scenes.context: Two people share materials while building a model.
models: They seem to get along with each other because they are sharing materials.
The project looks interesting, although some steps could be confusing.
I think one person looks confident while the other watches carefully.
scenes.suggestion: Describe how the people seem to work together. Give a visible clue.

scenes.title: Learning a new skill
scenes.alt: One person demonstrates a clay technique while another watches.
scenes.context: One person demonstrates a clay technique while another watches.
models: The learner looks interested in the demonstration.
The person demonstrating seems patient and confident.
Perhaps the learner admires this person and wants to learn more.
scenes.suggestion: Imagine why a learner might admire someone. Give a reason based on their actions.

scenes.title: Making space
scenes.alt: Someone pulls out a chair and gestures toward a person arriving.
scenes.context: Someone pulls out a chair and gestures toward a person arriving.
models: The person offering a chair seems welcoming.
The newcomer looks unsure, but perhaps they already know the group.
I think this looks like an invitation to join a discussion.
scenes.suggestion: If someone were being left out, how could another person stand up for them? The image does not prove exclusion.

scenes.title: Outside the frame
scenes.alt: Several people look in the same direction at something we cannot see.
scenes.context: Several people look in the same direction at something we cannot see.
models: They look surprised by something outside the picture.
Perhaps they are watching an exciting performance.
One person seems confused. I guess they do not all understand what is happening.
scenes.suggestion: Imagine a friendly question that could help someone share an impression. Sharing is optional.

scenes.title: Before the door opens
scenes.alt: A person holds a folder near a closed door and empty chairs.
scenes.context: A person holds a folder near a closed door and empty chairs.
models: She looks nervous because she is holding the folder close.
It looks like she is waiting for an appointment.
Perhaps she feels confident and is taking a moment to prepare.
scenes.suggestion: Suggest a gentle way to relax if the person feels nervous. Avoid giving an impatient order.

scenes.title: Picking things up
scenes.alt: Several people collect papers and pencils from the floor.
scenes.context: Several people collect papers and pencils from the floor.
models: One person might feel embarrassed about dropping the materials.
The others seem helpful because they are picking things up.
I think the person receiving the notebook looks grateful.
scenes.suggestion: Use this as a warm compliment for a helpful action, not as proof of someone’s whole personality.

frames: It looks like he needs help.
I guess he is waiting for a friend.
demo: It looks like a class presentation.
The classmates look interested. Perhaps the topic is interesting.
I think she is preparing to speak because she is holding her notes.
A friendly question could help break the ice.

open up.spanish: Abrirse y hablar de los sentimientos

reach out to.spanish: Contactar para ofrecer o pedir ayuda
